messages:
olivia: Morning — small heads-up: Helix on-prem cutover scheduled for Wed 09:00 UTC. We're missing final owners for: egress fallback, canary traffic, air-gapped image import, and kube manifest CR review. Please ping who can take these by EOD. tl;dr need owners + any blockers. :sunrise:
rajesh: I can take firewall/ACL verification. Need the customer's firewall egress IPs — @maya can we confirm the list?
emily: I can own egress prober & canary routing. Will set up synthetic probes and a canary route in staging. Quick Q: do we prefer curl-based prober or a tiny lambda?
ben: Leaving PR for the kube manifests — https://github.com/redwood-inference/helm-charts/pull/894 — it's mostly latebound config for nodeSelector and taints. Need someone to approve before Tuesday.
maya: ping @rajesh — customer Helix provided IP block 198.51.100.0/24 and 203.0.113.50. They enforce strict egress only to our NAT. I'll upload the firewall matrix to Confluence in a few.
rajesh: got it. I'll run through the matrix. Also need to confirm whether the NAT IPs are static during cutover window.
olivia: re: prober — prefer a lightweight curl prober deployed as a cronjob. Keep logs forwarded to observability. Emily, add to canary dashboard.
emily: will do. I'll also wire up a fallback policy: if 5xx > 2% for 5m, route to hosted model. Does that sound OK?
ben: ack on PR. tagging @olivia for ops-readme changes. Also adding a linter patch: please run `make yaml-lint` locally before merging.
sre-bot: reminder: scheduled maintenance window Wed 09:00-11:00 UTC on cluster prod-onprem-helix. See runbook: https://go/runbooks/helix-cutover
maya: about airgap image handoff — Helix accepts images via SFTP. We'll need signed tarballs and checksums. Example commands:
```
# on builder
docker save redwood/helium:release-2026-03 | gzip > helium.tar.gz
sha256sum helium.tar.gz > helium.sha256
# transfer via sftp
sftp helix@helix-host:/incoming/put/helium.tar.gz
```
I'll draft the handoff checklist and include checksums + sigs.
olivia: perfect. @ben please coordinate with release engineer to produce the signed tarball by Tue EOD.
ben: noted. Also small ask: can someone run a quick kubeversion smoke? We had an API change in v1.25 that affects admission webhooks.
rajesh: I can run smoke tomorrow morning and post results.
emily: I'll create the canary dashboard entries and post the panel links here.
olivia: thanks all. Owners: Firewall/ACL -> rajesh; Egress prober & canary -> emily; Kube manifests CR review -> ben; Airgap image handoff -> maya; Release packaging -> ben. If anyone needs help, drop a :hand:. We'll reconvene async status check Tue 16:00 UTC. Closing the loop.
ben: quick note — PR depends on `charts` version bump. If that isn't merged we can't cut the release. tagging @devex to queue.
devex: adding to release queue and will try to expedite chart bump.
